Final for Publication

SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE | Rezoning Attachment
2237 South Hoyne Avenue
From RS-3 to RM-6

The Property
The subject property is one zoning lot with two parcels Lot 36 and Lot 37 located in a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached
House) District.

The property is located in an Equitable Transit Served Location per the Chicago Zoning Ordinance and is approximately 1,910.0"
to the CTA Damen Pink Line Station entrance.

Lot 37 includes a two-story residential building with three units and Lot 36 includes a two-car detached garage.

The subject rezoning application is for Lot 36.

The Project

PL 2337 Hoyne LLC (the “Applicant”) seeks to rezone the property to divide the zoning lot into two individual zoning lots and
allow the Applicant to demolish the existing garage on Lot 36 and build a new three-story residential building (33.5 height) with
six dwelling units, and three surface parking spaces at the rear of lot 36.

The Applicant also seeks Type-1 application relief for Lot 36: optional Administrative Adjustment relief under section 17-13-1003
to reduce 3 required parking spaces to 2 for properties located in an Equitable Transit Served Location, and Variation relief under
section 17-13-1101 to reduce the front yard setback from 12.0’ to 0.0’, the north side setback from 3.35” to 0.7”, the south side
setback from 3.35’ to 3’-1”, and to relocate the on-site open space from to rear decks containing 193.5 square feet under section
17-13-1003-W.

To allow the proposed project, the Applicant seeks a change in zoning classification for the subject property from a RS-3, Residential
Singte-Unit (Detached House) District to a RM-6, Residential Multi-Unit District.

Lot 37 is to have a third-floor addition and two surface parking spaces at the rear of Lot 37 and is subject to its own rezoning
application.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project on Lot 36:
Lot Area: Lot 36: 2,379 square feet (subject lot)
Lot 37: 2,421 square feet

FAR: LOL

Floor Area: 4,557 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 6

MLA Density: 396.5 square feet

Height: 33.5’

Bicycle Parking: 6

Automobile Parking: 2*

On-Site Open Space: 193.5 square feet

Setbacks: Front (Hoyne): 0.0°*
North: 0.7°*
South: 37-1"
Rear (east/alley): 247-87"

A set of plans is attached,

* As mentioned above, the Applicant seeks optional Administrative Adjustment relief under section 17-13-0303-D to reduce parking
from three required automobile parking spaces to two under ETOD 50% parking requirement regulations and also seeks optional
Variation relief under section 17-13-1101 to reduce the front, north side and south side yard setbacks, and rear yard setbacks, and
to relocate required on-site open space to rear decks zero under 17-13-1003-W respectively.
